profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Steam Logistics

positions.title: Senior Software Developer
positions.description:
• Lead and managed team of developers to build products using Agile methodologies
• Mentored and guided junior developers to write clean and efficient code in a collaborative environment
• Engineered scalable systems from the ground up using Azure and Docker/Docker Compose
• Conduct client meetings to understand customer needs and demonstrate products to clients
• Developing front-end and back-end of business applications by utilizing technologies such as React, .NET, MUI, and MSSQL
• Used Typescript, C#, SQL, and HTML/CSS to build visually pleasing but efficient applications
• Built CI/CD pipelines to test, build, and deploy new releases to testing and production sites
• Provided ongoing maintenance of legacy software using JavaScript, Bootstrap, JQuery and .NET Framework
• Handled support for technical issues with production servers
positions.insights: C#, Microsoft SQL Server and +1 skill

positions.title: Software Application Developer
positions.description:
• Built software for clients such as Amazon Robotics and the Social Security Administration.
• Developing front-end and back-end of business applications by utilizing technologies such as Angular, Blazor, and .NET Core.
• Create 3D visualization software using Typescript, React, and ThreeJS.
• Manage databases at scale using MSSQL.
• Enhancing existing projects by utilizing test-driven development strategies.
• Implement unit testing into existing applications that support continuous integration.
• Implement continuous integration and continuous deployment into existing applications.
• Collaborate with others to develop back-end and front-end web applications.
• Debugging and resolving HTML/CSS Bootstrap, jQuery Ajax, and C# problems.
• Utilize cloud computing providers such as Azure and AWS to host scalable applications.

positions.title: Web Application Developer
positions.description:
•	Built frontend and backend of a comprehensive scheduling system utilizing an MSSQL database with Entity Framework on ASP.NET Core for the backend. 
•	Created detailed customer management panel for managing customers and quotes with HTML, JavaScript, and CSS.
•	Designed REST APIs to integrate and connect multiple systems running different architectures.
•	Utilized Microsoft Azure DevOps for continuous integration and continuous delivery, with Azure Pipelines keeping the staging website up to date with the latest changes.
